desc: Finished gray asphalt-shingle roof with a continuous low-profile dark ridge vent capped by matching ridge shingles, plus visible roof planes, soffit, and a louvered gable vent on a Florida home.
reuse_notes: Use for roof ridge vents, attic exhaust context, asphalt-shingle roof ventilation, and humidity-management articles. It depicts a generic completed roof detail, never a JK Prestige project or a substitute for determining ventilation area, roof compatibility, intake balance, wind ratings, or code requirements.
